decisive_items: Two symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules were present in the right and left inguinal folds adjacent to the scrotum
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies measuring 5-8 μm in diameter
Bacterial culture: Positive for E. coli
response.rationale: R2 specifies cutaneous malakoplakia, matching the inguinal/scrotal skin presentation, histiocytic infiltrate with Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, and associated E. coli infection. R1 identifies malakoplakia but lacks the cutaneous qualifier supported by the clinical context.

rejected.why: Less specific than R2; it names the systemic entity malakoplakia without incorporating the clearly cutaneous presentation and E. coli association.
